Aj Park: Quick FYI — platform team will start emitting `X-Route-Meta: compact-v2` as the canonical route hint next week. Right now it's opt-in, but we'll promote it to authoritative in two weeks.
Maria S: "Wait, authoritative meaning SDKs should stop sending legacy headers?"
Samir: Can you share the exact compact-v2 shape? our client libs rely on `X-Route-Pref` + `X-Route-Tags`.
Aj Park: Schema sketch below (compact, key=value pairs):
```
X-Route-Meta: v2;route=compact(abc123);quota_group=team-a;seed=42
```
Irene: How does this affect quota attribution in the console? don't want dashboards to collapse for tenants that haven't switched.
Console Team: We'll implement a migration mapping: for 7 days console will infer v2 from legacy headers and surface a mismatch flag. After that, we'll only count v2 for new attribution unless tenant toggles mapping.
Samir: SDK impact: python/ts/go libs currently emit `X-Route-Pref` and `X-Route-Tags`. Options: 1) Add a shim that reads v2 if present, else synthesizes v2 from legacy headers; 2) Start emitting v2 and keep legacy until deprecation window.
Dexter: This could be breaking for customers reading raw headers. We need an opt-out environment or compatibility flag in SDKs.
Aj Park: Agreed — plan is: canary opt-in (1%) next Tue, then 25%, 100% over two weeks. SDKs should ship a non-breaking shim that prefers v2 but falls back. Platform will continue to accept legacy headers for 30 days if SDKs can't ship.
Maria S: Proposed python shim (very small):
```python
def build_route_meta(headers):
    if 'X-Route-Meta' in headers:
        return headers['X-Route-Meta']
    # synthesize from legacy headers
    parts = []
    if 'X-Route-Pref' in headers:
        parts.append(f"route={headers['X-Route-Pref']}")
    if 'X-Route-Tags' in headers:
        parts.append(f"tags={headers['X-Route-Tags']}")
    return 'v2;' + ';'.join(parts)
```
Samir: Looks good. Add an explicit sampling bit so telemetry can separate canary vs normal: `sample=0|1`.
Irene: Console needs a per-tenant migration toggle and an audit trail. I'll add a dashboard tile showing v2 vs legacy traffic and mismatches.
Aj Park: We'll also expose `REDWOOD_ROUTE_V2_OPTIN` env var for SDKs and a runtime flag to force legacy passthrough.
Samir: Timeline — we need at least five business days to cut patches for Python/TS/Go and run integration tests.
Aj Park: Branch cut tomorrow; docs + release notes by Friday. If SDKs can't make it, platform keeps legacy acceptance for 30 days and emits deprecation warnings in logs.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to 1% — status: ok, 12 requests sampled, 0 errors :rocket:
Irene: I'll coordinate console mapping and start a nightly job to tag mismatches so we can reach out to tenants early.
Dexter: I'll open SDK PRs (python/ts/go) with the shim and opt-out env; will link here.
Samir: I'll run compatibility tests against internal services and report edgecases (header casing, proxies, client side rewrites).
Aj Park: thanks all. Keep updates in this thread for rollout questions and telemetry gaps. :thumbsup:
